item.title: Cost of Living in Caulfield South Melbourne

Is Caulfield South Expensive?

Caulfield South sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Caulfield South, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
